force_scope: Taliban Afghan-origin fighters plus Northern Alliance fighters; excludes foreign fighters
derivation_or_method: ( midpoint of 40,000–45,000 Taliban fighters minus midpoint of 8,000–12,000 foreign fighters ) plus midpoint of 22,000–25,000 Northern Alliance fighters = 32,500 + 23,500 = 56,000
limitation: Aggregates opposing territorial conflict factions; not a national armed-forces headcount, and source ranges are uncertain.

force_scope: Sovereign national armed forces attributed to Antarctica
derivation_or_method: No sovereign Antarctic national armed force is represented in the country row; foreign military personnel supporting peaceful research are excluded rather than asserted absent
limitation: The treaty permits military personnel and equipment for peaceful research; zero refers only to a national-force scenario slot, not all military personnel physically present.

force_scope: Kosovo Protection Corps active establishment ceiling; civilian emergency service
derivation_or_method: Use the 3,000 active-member ceiling only as a bounded service-size context value; do not treat it as an observed 2001 military count
source_name: United Nations Interim Administration Mission in Kosovo
limitation: The KPC was defined as a civilian emergency service, the value is an authorized ceiling, and a separate 2,000-member reserve ceiling is not included.

force_scope: Carabiniers du Prince only; excludes other public-force bodies
derivation_or_method: Carry the official 2002 corps headcount backward one year as a near-year component reference; do not claim a complete Monaco force total
source_reference: Monaco en chiffres 2002, section 3-2, Force Publique
limitation: The 112-person value is for Carabiniers du Prince in 2002, not a complete 2001 count of all Monaco military-status or security bodies.

force_scope: Federal Yugoslav Army personnel and military police stationed in Montenegro
derivation_or_method: Sum the reported 14,000 VJ troops and 1,000 military police present in Montenegro from 2000 to 2001
source_reference: Republic of Montenegro – SALW Survey, 2004-07-31, p. 9; citing Jane's Intelligence Digest 2000–2001
limitation: This is the territory-based presence of a federal army, not a separate Montenegrin national force. The same survey's 14,227 MUP figure includes police and a reserve defence force and is not active military strength.

force_scope: Separate Puerto Rico national active armed forces
derivation_or_method: Use zero for a separate national active-force slot; Puerto Rico had no sovereign military, while the Army National Guard is a U.S. reserve component
limitation: This excludes U.S. federal active-duty personnel stationed in Puerto Rico and excludes the Puerto Rico Army National Guard reserve component.

force_scope: Palestinian Authority police authorized across the West Bank and Gaza
derivation_or_method: Retain the reported upper authorization limit as a ceiling context value; do not substitute it for actual strength
source_reference: Child Soldiers Global Report 2001, published 2001-05, Palestine country report
limitation: The report says actual force numbers were not declared and notes widespread ghosting; 30,000 is not an observed headcount and includes police services.

force_scope: Regular Solomon Islands armed forces only; excludes paramilitary/security units
derivation_or_method: The Factbook explicitly reports no regular military forces; retain zero only for the regular-force scope, not all armed security bodies
source_reference: Solomon Islands entry, 2001 edition, Military field
limitation: The entry also lists the National Reconnaissance and Surveillance Force and police; their headcount and WDI-equivalent paramilitary classification are unknown.

force_scope: Gendarmerie and Guardie di Rocca military units
derivation_or_method: No numeric estimate is derived because contemporary sources identify units but publish no compatible strength
source_reference: Child Soldiers Global Report 2001, published 2001-05, San Marino country report
limitation: The source identifies two small units without a headcount; zero would be unsupported.

force_scope: Former soldiers and recruits registered for planned army formation
derivation_or_method: Preserve the contemporary approximate registration pool as context; do not treat it as active-force strength
source_reference: “Committees oversee formation of national army,” published 2001-07-24
limitation: The defence minister explicitly said he could not provide an accurate count; the pool included former soldiers and recruits in training.

force_scope: SPLA and allied forces in southern Sudan
derivation_or_method: Do not assign a sovereign-country national-force count to a state that did not exist in 2001; preserve rebel-force context separately if the game models factions
source_name: U.S. Department of State; United Nations
source_reference: Sudan 2001 human-rights report published 2002-03-04; South Sudan country history
limitation: SPLA strength estimates refer to a rebel organization in Sudan and are not comparable to a South Sudan national active-force series.
